description: This PHP class 'SkillService' provides various methods to manage 'Skill' entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities. It acts as a service layer in an HRM system for handling skills-related business logic.

classes.name: SkillService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for managing 'Skill' entities, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and searching, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSkillDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of SkillDao.

methods.name: setSkillDao
methods.description: Sets the SkillDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Saves a Skill entity using the DAO.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple Skills based on provided IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for skills based on filter parameters, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills matching filter parameters, with exception handling.
